decisions.reason: This control unit is very close to the firm’s core airfield lighting and control knowledge, so management can learn from early installations and improve it with existing engineering capabilities.
An air situation display is adjacent to the firm’s airport systems base, and its integration value with other airport products gives enough related knowledge to justify continued development.
The training program builds on the firm’s installed-base know-how and customer relationships, though as a service offering it is somewhat easier to scale back if demand proves limited.
This training course is tightly linked to the firm’s strongest technical domain in airfield ground lighting, making it relatively easy to adapt and support from existing knowledge.
A collaboration software tool is less closely tied to an electrical equipment knowledge base and requires software-centric learning capabilities that are harder to absorb and exploit commercially.

The multilateration surveillance system is a technologically demanding but strategically related airport product, and the firm is likely to retain it because its R&D and system-integration knowledge can be leveraged across the portfolio.
